sum: FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc., an embodied AI robotics company, focuses on the research and development, manufacturing, commercialization, and deployment of intelligent robotic technologies, products, and industry solutions. It is building a Four-Core Full-Stack AI ecosystem covering the lifecycle of robotics consisting of physical AI brain and developer platform, physical AI devices, physical AI industry productivity solutions, and physical AI data factory. The company also operates RoboShare, a robot-sharing and services platform. It has strategic partnership with California Science and Technology University and Boston International Business School for robotics education, talent development, and innovation. The company was formerly known as AIxCrypto Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. in September 2026. FF EAI Robotics Ecosystem Inc. is headquartered in El Segundo, California.
